items.cmd: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/playwright pnpm exec playwright install chromium && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/playwright node --test scripts/copy-conversation.test.mjs
items.expect: Proposed, not executed. Start an isolated browser with a synthetic conversation and a deterministic provider. Enter exactly “Explain **order**.”; return exactly “First, keep `a`.”; enter exactly “Then what?”; return a card-only question exactly “Which comes next?” with choices “A” and “B”. Collapse earlier steps. Activate the single whole-conversation text control, then paste into a plain textarea. Assert Markdown contains both learner messages, the tutor reply and the card-only question, once each, in that order, with distinct speaker labels and unchanged punctuation. Reload and repeat with restored history. Exercise a live reply so the control cannot silently produce an incomplete conversation while reporting success. Deny clipboard writes and assert no success state is announced. Inspect narrow and desktop layouts for one text control; visual quietness is judged separately. Revert the copy handler or serializer guard and confirm the clipboard-content assertion fails.
items.failure_case: A copy that omits a collapsed or card-only turn, changes turn order, leaks learner protocol instructions, or announces success after a denied clipboard write must fail.
items.missing: Add scripts/copy-conversation.test.mjs using node:test and Playwright. It must own deterministic browser/server setup, clipboard paste coverage, restored and live-request cases, and assertions for denied writes and card-only turns. The browser invocation and new assertions are not yet implemented.

items.failure_case: A pill-shaped, bordered or badge-bearing copy control must not pass the yohaku judgment.
items.how_to_judge: Taste inspects the built conversation at narrow and desktop widths, in light and dark themes, including focus and copied feedback states. Does one quiet text control fit the existing interface without added chrome, pills, borders or badges? The answer can require visual or wording repairs; it does not accept teaching changes.
items.statement: The control keeps the yohaku look: no added chrome, pills, borders or badges.
items.description: The control keeps the yohaku look: no added chrome, pills, borders or badges.
